purpose: Fresh synthetic validation reserve registered after September 30 development fixes. Do not tune prompts or code on these cases and call the same file held out afterward.
evaluationOrder: Freeze this corpus and global semantic criteria before generation. Score raw generation, current policy readiness, and human semantic quality separately.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: A usable draft or an appropriate missing-source refusal preserves recipient, facts, uncertainty, exact literals, restrictions, and writer-versus-recipient intent. Style directions are applied without leaking into message content.
semanticCriteria.critical: Invented consequential facts or actions, lost named recipient, changed negation or uncertainty, dropped explicit no-action limits, changed technical literals, or source-free fabricated content that reaches review.
semanticCriteria.minor: Style or concision direction missed without material meaning loss, or harmless extra wording.
semanticCriteria.gate: At least 95 percent acceptable and zero critical failures over the complete case set; blocked unsafe output counts as safe recovery but not a successful draft.
